result.reason: The operative language does not state that Customer owns Type I Materials or include an assignment from IBM; the margin comment cannot supply that missing ownership term. Because unspecified Materials default to Type I, those Materials have neither express Customer ownership nor the fallback licence granted for Type II Materials. IBM also remains able to designate service-created Materials as Type II. Although the Type II licence, Customer Data protection, and no-joint-ownership provision generally track the playbook, the missing Type I ownership language is fatal. The orphaned numbering and awkward phrasing also reduce drafting quality.
